decisions.reason: Requiring standalone understanding for viewers unfamiliar with Arden does not change the existing criterion to select substantive lessons, stories, or real points.
The standalone-understandability refinement does not change the permitted source collection or source-exclusion rule.
The narrative-understandability refinement does not alter the independently specified 70-to-85-second duration range.
Making a clip understandable to an unfamiliar viewer does not necessarily change its hook-selection criterion.
Clean editing and prohibited visual treatments are addressed by a separate clause in the same message and are not changed by the standalone-narrative decision.
The narrative-understandability refinement does not change the assigned count, batch work, or delivery scope; those are governed by separate clauses.
Background-music volume is an independent requirement introduced by another clause in the source message.
The requirement that clips be understandable to unfamiliar viewers does not alter the approval gate or approving authority.
Contextual B-roll integration is independently established by separate clauses and is not changed by the standalone-understandability refinement.
Standalone narrative understanding does not change the existing white-text-only and no-text-effects rules.
The source decision does not mention or logically change the requirement to use the exact brand-guideline font.
The clip narrative refinement does not change any dedicated Instagram account setup or audience-routing attributes.
